answer: Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. The jetty detector writes each match to the anchor queue, and the zenith checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. A submitter whose answers share 4 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 57% of its pending payouts meanwhile.
